author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:

Former Overwatch boss Jeff Kaplan has some advice for gamers who complain about games they'll never play: 'Shut the f*** up. No one cares.' The harsh words came during a 10-hour livestream showcasing his new project, The Legend of California, a first-person survival game set during California's Gold Rush period. In other news, Capcom's Resident Evil Requiem is now the franchise's fastest-selling game, with now 6 million copies sold since its launch in late Febrary. And finally, LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight's release date has been moved up, from May 29 to May 22. This release window was previously taken up by Grand Theft Auto 6, which was delayed to later this year.
title: Ex-Overwatch Boss: 'Shut the F*** Up' About Games You'll Never Play - IGN Daily Fix

description:
The first installment of the Yakuza series, boasting over 30 million units shipped worldwide, is brought to life in a live-action, mini-series adaptation that remains faithful to the story of the original game. Produced by the cast and crew of the hit Japanese gangster drama “Nihon Touitsu” in close collaboration with Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio. 

Episode 1:
A city swirling with desire and violence... Kamurocho. The legendary yakuza once known as the Dragon of Dojima, Kazuma Kiryu, takes the fall for his best friend who killed their patriarch. Ten years later, guided by fate, he returns to Kamurocho once more. But what awaited him were former members of his own organization who now hated him, a dangerous trap, and a series of mysterious incidents further corner him.

Mark (voiced by Steven Yeun) battles Dinosaurus (voiced by Matthew Rhys) in this exclusive sneak peek at Episode 401 of Invincible.

While the world recovers from catastrophe, a changed Mark fights to protect his home and the people he loves, setting him on a collision course with a threat that could alter the fate of humanity forever.

Based on the award-winning comic book series by co-creators Robert Kirkman and Cory Walker, and contributing creator Ryan Ottley,  Invincible stars Steven Yeun, Sandra Oh, and J.K. Simmons. Additional cast also includes Gillian Jacobs, Seth Rogen, Walton Goggins, Lee Pace, Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Jason Mantzoukas, Zazie Beetz, Grey DeLisle, Zachary Quinto, Chris Diamantopoulos, Ross Marquand, Khary Payton, Andrew Rannells, Kevin Michael Richardson, Ben Schwartz, Clancy Brown, Jay Pharoah, Mark Hamill, Matthew Rhys, Danai Gurira, and Melise.

author: IGN
description:
Invincible’s fourth season performs a much-needed reset, setting a definitive course for its character arcs right from the word go. In the first 6 of its 8 episodes, the show’s signature gore is matched by its emotional brutality, as it confronts questions that have been hovering in the background by finally placing them front-and-center. Namely: is Mark, or Invincible, really like his father? Can Nolan, the former Omni-Man, ever be forgiven for his crimes? And is it truly possible for them to become better people?
Watch our review of Invincible Season 4, Episodes 1-6 for the full story!

description:
Take a look at your objectives and what you can expect from Solar Expanse in this trailer for the upcoming space economy sim. Solar Expanse focuses on expanding our economic influence over the entire Solar System (and other systems in the later stages) in different periods, from the modern day to the not-millennia-far future. Solar Expanse will be available in Early Access on PC on April 9, 2026.

Solar Expanse tries to envision the real process of planning space missions, including costs, timelines, resource management, various spacecrafts and launch vehicles, and economic weight of the endeavors, as well as a possible trade between us, and other national and private agencies. The endgame also allows players to terraform planets and build an interstellar ship.

#ign #gaming
title: Solar Expanse - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
